name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Between Envy and Spite, one goes with Holloway and the other with Pierce.
Kitchen goes with Spite if and only if Holloway does not go with Ballroom.
Envy goes with at least one of Ashford or Kitchen.

hints.text: Suppose Ashford went with Envy — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Ashford goes with Envy.
Envy goes with Ashford, so Holloway can't go with Envy.
Envy goes with Ashford, so Pierce can't go with Envy.
…but now the clue “Between Envy and Spite, one goes with Holloway and the other with Pierce” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Ashford does not go with Envy.
